notes.title: Major Update: Brown Map
notes.content:
- Improved optimization.
- Fixed some bugs and problems.
- Brown (First) Map is gone.

Cave map is removed from the game. Now you will start the game as you have escaped the cave and you will get into the action in the beginning.


Dev Note: As you know, I developed this game alone. Brown map was the first thing I developed in the engine. I learned as I made this game. I am sorry for everyone who hate the game because of that map.
